title: 〜がち
simpleExplanation: 〜がち says that something undesirable happens often or easily: 遅刻しがちだ = tends to be late; 病気がち = sickly. It attaches to the ます stem of a verb or to a noun and works like a な-adjective (がちだ, がちな, がちに).
whenUsed: Speech and writing about habits, health, and tendencies. Almost always for negative tendencies: 忘れがち, 遠慮がち, 留守がち, 曇りがち, 偏りがち.
formation: Followed by だ / な + Noun / に + Verb

diagram.title: がち / 気味 / やすい

examples.ja: 最近、仕事が忙しくて、遅刻しがちだ。
examples.reading: さいきん、しごとがいそがしくて、ちこくしがちだ。
examples.en: Lately I've been busy with work and tend to be late.
examples.note: V-ます + がちだ: tends to be late.

examples.ja: 子供の頃は病気がちだった。
examples.reading: こどものころはびょうきがちだった。
examples.en: I was sickly as a child.
examples.note: N + がち + だった: was sickly.

examples.ja: 一人暮らしだと、食事が偏りがちになる。
examples.reading: ひとりぐらしだと、しょくじがかたよりがちになる。
examples.en: Living alone, your diet tends to become unbalanced.
examples.note: がちになる: becomes prone to.

examples.ja: 冬は運動不足になりがちなので、意識して歩くようにしている。
examples.reading: ふゆはうんどうぶそくになりがちなので、いしきしてあるくようにしている。
examples.en: In winter I tend to get too little exercise, so I make a point of walking.

examples.ja: 父は出張が多くて、家を留守にしがちだ。
examples.reading: ちちはしゅっちょうがおおくて、いえをるすにしがちだ。
examples.en: My father travels a lot for work and is often away from home.
examples.note: 留守にしがち / 留守がち.

similarGrammar.difference: A slight present state (疲れ気味 = a bit tired now). がち is a repeated tendency.
A quality or appearance; がち is about frequency of an action or state.

commonMistakes.why: がち is for undesirable tendencies; success is not.
Verbs attach with the ます stem.

commonMistakes.wrong: 今日は風邪がちだ。(intended: slight cold today)
commonMistakes.why: A present slight state is 気味; がち means "often gets colds".

usageNotes: Almost always negative outcomes. Common: 忘れがち, 遠慮がち, 留守がち, 曇りがち. Compare 〜やすい (easy to / likely to, neutral) and 〜気味 (slight state now).
Adverb form: 遠慮がちに話す (speak hesitantly).
jlptTips: A negative tendency stated generally (often, tends to) = がち; a slight state right now = 気味.
A positive tendency rules out がち; look for another option.
The stem is the ます stem; 遅刻するがち is a wrong option.
